answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because vine only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice orchard is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any onyx approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
